  text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[⎢], [0], [1], [0], text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[⎥],

The grid above is the identity matrix, built the way older equation editors build it.

label: Box-drawing characters in a directory tree

#text(font: "DejaVu Sans Mono", size: 9pt)[#raw("app/
├── renderer/
│   └── main.js
└── electron/
    └── tts.js")]

The tree shows where the two scripts live.

label: Dot leaders in a table of contents
on_page: Three table-of-contents lines with dotted leaders to page numbers.
ideal: Chapter 1, Vectors and Scalars, page 17. Chapter 2, The Calculus of Motion, page 43. Chapter 3, Springs, page 81.
typst_source:
#box(width: 10cm)[Chapter 1 Vectors and Scalars #box(width: 1fr, repeat[.]) 17] \
#box(width: 10cm)[Chapter 2 The Calculus of Motion #box(width: 1fr, repeat[.]) 43] \
#box(width: 10cm)[Chapter 3 Springs #box(width: 1fr, repeat[.]) 81]

label: Running header and page number
on_page: Body text; the furniture itself is in the header/footer of every page.
ideal: Every page of this document carries a running header and a page number in the footer. (Header and page number never spoken.)
typst_source: Every page of this document carries a running header ("Blitz text test bench") and a page number in the footer. Neither should be read aloud, and neither should be glued onto the first or last sentence of a page.

label: A sentence broken across a page
on_page: One long sentence flowing over a page break.
ideal: The whole sentence as one unit, with no page number or header inside it.
typst_source: This sentence is placed at the very bottom of a page so that it has to continue on the next page, which means the page number and the running header sit in the middle of it when the text is extracted page by page, and a reader that segments one page at a time will cut it into two pieces, each of which it will then treat as a sentence of its own, with the first piece ending in mid-air and the second piece starting in the middle of a clause that the listener has already half forgotten by the time the next page has been fetched, rendered and read.

label: Private-use glyph (icon font)
on_page: A pointing-hand icon whose ToUnicode entry was rewritten to private-use U+F0E0 (post-processed), then a sentence.
ideal: (icon skipped, or 'Note:') Keep the lid closed while the centrifuge is spinning.
note: Post-processed: ToUnicode for ☞ remapped to U+F0E0, as icon fonts do.
typst_source: #text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[☞] Keep the lid closed while the centrifuge is spinning.

label: Unmappable glyph arriving as a control character
on_page: Δp and Δt, with the Δ glyph's ToUnicode rewritten to U+0003 (post-processed), as in Millington p.60.
ideal: The impulse equals the change in momentum, delta p, over the short interval delta t.
note: Post-processed: ToUnicode for Δ in this font remapped to U+0003.
typst_source: The impulse equals the change in momentum, #text(font: "DejaVu Serif")[Δ]p, over the short interval #text(font: "DejaVu Serif")[Δ]t.

label: Zero-width space inside a word
on_page: 'database' and 'timestamp' each containing an invisible U+200B.
ideal: The database was rebuilt overnight, and the timestamp column was kept.
typst_source: The data#sym.zws;base was rebuilt overnight, and the time#sym.zws;stamp column was kept.

label: Soft hyphen inside a word
on_page: 'hyperparameter' and 'metaparameter' each containing an invisible U+00AD soft hyphen.
ideal: Tune one hyperparameter at a time, and never more than one metaparameter.
typst_source: Tune one hyper#"\u{00AD}"parameter at a time, and never more than one meta#"\u{00AD}"parameter.

label: Decorative bullets
on_page: Three lines starting with the ornaments ❖ ➤ ■.
ideal: Weigh the sample. Dissolve it in water. Record the temperature.
typst_source:
#text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[❖] Weigh the sample. \
#text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[➤] Dissolve it in water. \
#text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[■] Record the temperature.

label: Labels inside a figure
on_page: A boxed plot with axis labels 'v (m/s)', 't (s)', '0', point labels A and B, and a caption.
ideal: Figure 1: Velocity against time for a falling ball. (Labels inside the plot are not read.)
typst_source:
#figure(box(width: 7cm, height: 3cm, stroke: 0.5pt)[
  #place(top + left, dx: 3pt, dy: 3pt)[v (m/s)]
  #place(bottom + right, dx: -3pt, dy: -3pt)[t (s)]
  #place(bottom + left, dx: 3pt, dy: -3pt)[0]
  #place(center + horizon)[A]
  #place(top + right, dx: -12pt, dy: 12pt)[B]
  #place(bottom + left, line(start: (10pt, -8pt), end: (180pt, -70pt), stroke: 0.6pt))
], caption: [Velocity against time for a falling ball.])

label: Ornamental section break
on_page: Two sentences separated by a centred row of fleurons.
ideal: The first scene ends here. (pause) The second scene begins the next morning.
typst_source:
The first scene ends here.
#align(center)[#text(font: "DejaVu Sans")[❧ ❧ ❧]]
The second scene begins the next morning.

label: Line numbers in a code listing

ideal: (code announced or read without the gutter numbers) The loop on line 2 adds every element.
typst_source:

  text(size: 9pt)[#raw("let total = 0;\nfor (const x of xs) total += x;\nreturn total;")])
The loop on line 2 adds every element.

label: Watermark behind the text

typst_source: This page carries a large diagonal SPECIMEN watermark behind the body text. It is decoration, not content.

typst_source: The change Δx is small compared with x itself.

ideal: The angles alpha, beta and theta sum to pi, and lambda is the wavelength while sigma is the spread.
typst_source: The angles α, β and θ sum to π, and λ is the wavelength while σ is the spread.

label: Comparison signs
ideal: If x is less than or equal to 5 and y is greater than or equal to 2, then x not equal to y need not hold, and pi is approximately 3.14.
typst_source: If x ≤ 5 and y ≥ 2, then x ≠ y need not hold, and π ≈ 3.14.

label: Plus-minus, times, divide
ideal: The rod is 12 plus or minus 0.5 centimetres long; 3 times 4 equals 12 and 12 divided by 3 equals 4.
typst_source: The rod is 12 ± 0.5 cm long; 3 × 4 = 12 and 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

label: Degrees

ideal: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius, the body sits near 37 degrees Celsius, and a right angle is 90 degrees.
typst_source: Water boils at 100 °C, the body sits near 37 °C, and a right angle is 90°.

on_page: % and ‰
ideal: Prices rose 15 percent this year, and the salinity is 35 per mille.
typst_source: Prices rose 15% this year, and the salinity is 35‰.

label: Currencies
on_page: $ € £ ¥ ₹ before amounts.
ideal: It cost 5 dollars 99 here, 20 euros in Paris, 3 pounds in London, 500 yen in Tokyo and 100 rupees in Delhi.
typst_source: It cost \$5.99 here, €20 in Paris, £3 in London, ¥500 in Tokyo and ₹100 in Delhi.

ideal: Each cell is 10 micrometres wide, the dose is 5 micrograms per decilitre, and g equals 9.81 metres per second squared.
typst_source: Each cell is 10 µm wide, the dose is 5 µg/dL, and g = 9.81 m/s².

label: Vulgar fractions
on_page: ½ ¾ ⅓
ideal: Add half a cup of flour; three quarters of the class passed and one third stayed behind.
typst_source: Add ½ cup of flour; ¾ of the class passed and ⅓ stayed behind.

label: Unicode superscripts and subscripts
on_page: x² y³ 10⁻⁵ H₂O CO₂ as Unicode characters.
ideal: We have x squared plus y cubed, a rate of ten to the minus five per second, and water is H 2 O while C O 2 is a gas.
typst_source: We have x² + y³, a rate of 10⁻⁵ per second, and water is H₂O while CO₂ is a gas.

label: Typeset superscripts and subscripts
on_page: The same as S-10 but raised/lowered ordinary digits, as most PDFs do it.
ideal: Same as S-10: x squared plus y cubed, ten to the minus five, H 2 O, C O 2.
typst_source: We have x#super(typographic: false)[2] + y#super(typographic: false)[3], a rate of 10#super(typographic: false)[−5] per second, and water is H#sub(typographic: false)[2]O while CO#sub(typographic: false)[2] is a gas.

label: Arrows
ideal: The reaction A to B (A goes to B) is fast, the rule p implies q is a premise, and prices went up while sales went down.
typst_source: The reaction A → B is fast, the rule p ⇒ q is a premise, and prices went ↑ while sales went ↓.

label: Primes

ideal: Compare f prime of x with f double prime of x; the shelf is 5 feet 11 inches tall.
typst_source: Compare f′(x) with f″(x); the shelf is 5′ 11″ tall.

label: Big operators as text

ideal: The sum of the terms diverges, the integral from 0 to infinity converges, and the square root of 2 is irrational.
typst_source: The ∑ of the terms diverges, the ∫ from 0 to ∞ converges, and √2 is irrational.

label: Set and logic symbols
ideal: For every x in S there is a y not in T; for all epsilon greater than 0 there exists delta greater than 0 such that the bound holds.
typst_source: For every x ∈ S there is a y ∉ T; ∀ε > 0 ∃δ > 0 such that the bound holds.

ideal: The probability P of A rises with the parameter theta, and n is the sample size.
typst_source: The probability 𝑃(𝐴) rises with the parameter 𝜽, and 𝑛 is the sample size.

ideal: Let f be defined as g plus 1, assume a is proportional to b, and note that A is a subset of B.
typst_source: Let 𝑓 ≜ 𝑔 + 1, assume a ∝ b, and note that A ⊆ B.

label: Section, copyright and trademark signs

typst_source: See § 4.2 and ¶ 3; the text is © 2026 Blitz, and Kokoro™ is named here only as an example®.

label: Ellipsis
on_page: Single-character ellipsis U+2026.

which is the derivative of position.

$ R = mat(cos theta, -sin theta; sin theta, cos theta) $
for an angle $theta$.

ideal: x squared plus y squared equals r squared.
